searchText: Deprecation notice for **Goerli Shadow Fork 4**. If any teams are still using GSF4 for testing please reach out, otherwise we'll deprecate it over the next few days Mainnet-shadow-fork-7 configs are out: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-7 TTD is planned to be reached on Wednesday (22nd June) at ~2PM UTC. We have an equal client split for all validators. The aim is to test the fixes deployed on ropsten and make sure there are no regressions. I'll be running a round of updates + TTD override on Tuesday (21st), if there's anything please do reach out. Tooling links: https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork7.ethdevops.io/ https://explorer.mainnetshadowfork7.ethdevops.io/ https://beaconchain.mainnetshadowfork7.ethdevops.io/ <@&595683849225240704> do lighthouse now have the `sepolia` `--network=`option made a PR https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/3268 you can also use `--testnet-dir <CONFIG-DIRECTORY>` instead. Just point it to this directory https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/sepolia

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Mainnet-shadow-fork-7 configs are out: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-7

TTD is planned to be reached on Wednesday (22nd June) at ~2PM UTC.  We have an equal client split for all validators. The aim is to test the fixes deployed on ropsten and make sure there are no regressions. 

I'll be running a round of updates + TTD override on Tuesday (21st), if there's anything please do reach out.

Tooling links:
https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork7.ethdevops.io/
https://explorer.mainnetshadowfork7.ethdevops.io/
https://beaconchain.mainnetshadowfork7.ethdevops.io/
